purpose: Precommit the statistical interpretation of the untouched holdout evaluation before inspecting holdout outcomes.
paired_unit: holdout seed within operating regime; each seed deterministically defines the matched synthetic mobility scenario and traffic trace for predictive and reactive policies
primary_comparison: deadline_aware_lifetime at the development-selected frozen fairness weight minus reactive_greedy

interval.method: paired percentile bootstrap over seed-level differences

multiplicity.confirmatory_tests: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on goodput for the four regimes, when defined
multiplicity.correction: Holm across the four regime-level primary tests

secondary_interpretation: descriptive and mechanism-supporting; do not override the primary goodput classification
guardrails: Do not alter the selected fairness weight after holdout inspection.
Do not redefine regimes, seeds, practical margin, confidence level, bootstrap count, or classification thresholds after holdout inspection.
If the development gate selected no weight, do not inspect holdout outcomes for selection.
Treat this as executed diagnostic synthetic evidence, not canonical WOMD evidence or final publication inference.
